understandings.studentTitle: Amphipathic lipids self-assemble into bilayers
understandings.draftSummary: Heads face each aqueous environment; both sets of tails face each other in the hydrophobic core.

understandings.studentTitle: Hydrophobic cores restrict polar solutes
understandings.draftSummary: A charged hydrated ion encounters a nonpolar core; losing its hydration shell is energetically unfavourable.

understandings.studentTitle: Simple diffusion moves small gases down gradients
understandings.draftSummary: O2 continues crossing in both directions, with equal average rates so that net flux is zero.

understandings.studentTitle: Integral and peripheral proteins perform distinct roles
understandings.draftSummary: Integral is embedded in one or both lipid leaflets; peripheral associates with a membrane face.

understandings.studentTitle: Osmosis and aquaporins govern net water movement
understandings.draftSummary: Individual water molecules move randomly; unequal opposing flows produce the net change.

understandings.studentTitle: Ion channels enable selective facilitated diffusion
understandings.draftSummary: It supplies a selective low-energy route; its ions move downhill without the channel consuming ATP to drive transport.

understandings.studentTitle: ATP-powered pumps establish concentration gradients
understandings.draftSummary: A channel permits downhill transport; a pump couples a conformational cycle to energy to move solutes uphill.

understandings.studentTitle: Membranes combine selective and property-dependent permeability
understandings.draftSummary: Size and hydrophobic/polar character affect bilayer crossing; channels, carriers and pumps introduce selectivity.

understandings.studentTitle: Extracellular glycans assist recognition and adhesion
understandings.draftSummary: The extracellular/noncytosolic face, where they contribute to recognition and adhesion.

understandings.studentTitle: The fluid mosaic model integrates lipid and protein components
understandings.draftSummary: Bilayer phospholipids, hydrophilic heads, hydrophobic tails, integral protein, peripheral protein, glycoprotein/external glycan and cholesterol.

understandings.studentTitle: Fatty-acid saturation tunes membrane flexibility
understandings.draftSummary: Cis double bonds bend chains and hinder close packing, often lowering the phase-transition temperature.

understandings.studentTitle: Cholesterol buffers animal membrane fluidity
understandings.draftSummary: Hydroxyl group near hydrophilic head region; nonpolar ring system among hydrocarbon tails.

understandings.studentTitle: Membrane flexibility permits endocytosis and exocytosis
understandings.draftSummary: Endocytosis buds inward and brings extracellular material inside; exocytosis fuses outward and releases lumenal material.

understandings.studentTitle: Chemical and voltage signals gate neuronal channels
understandings.draftSummary: ACh ligand binding gates nicotinic receptors; membrane-potential changes gate voltage-sensitive Na+ channels.

understandings.studentTitle: The sodium–potassium pump exchanges ions and maintains gradients
understandings.draftSummary: Per ATP: three Na+ out, two K+ in; electrogenic action and gradient maintenance support membrane potentials.

understandings.studentTitle: Sodium gradients power glucose cotransport
understandings.draftSummary: ATPase lowers intracellular Na+; Na+ subsequently moves downhill through an apical SGLT and can drive glucose uptake uphill.

understandings.studentTitle: Cell-adhesion molecules hold tissues together
understandings.draftSummary: Different junctions use different adhesion molecules to make and stabilize specific cell-cell contacts.

understandings.studentTitle: Organelles are cell subunits specialized for functions
understandings.draftSummary: Nuclei, vesicles, ribosomes and plasma membranes count; cell wall, cytoskeleton and cytoplasm do not.

understandings.studentTitle: Separating transcription and translation permits RNA processing
understandings.draftSummary: RNA can be processed and regulated in the nucleus before mature mRNA encounters cytoplasmic ribosomes.

understandings.studentTitle: Cytoplasmic compartments concentrate and isolate reactions
understandings.draftSummary: Enzyme/metabolite concentration and incompatible-reaction separation; lysosomes and phagocytic vacuoles illustrate bounded digestion.

understandings.studentTitle: Mitochondrial architecture supports aerobic ATP synthesis
understandings.draftSummary: Cristae: inner-membrane area; small intermembrane space: gradient compartment; matrix: Krebs enzymes/substrates; double membrane: distinct spaces.

understandings.studentTitle: Chloroplast membrane spaces organize photosynthesis
understandings.draftSummary: Thylakoid membrane, thylakoid lumen and stroma, respectively.

understandings.studentTitle: A double nuclear envelope regulates exchange and division
understandings.draftSummary: Segregates nuclear processing, permits selective pore traffic; in open mitosis/meiosis, envelope disassembles and later reforms.

understandings.studentTitle: Free and ER-bound ribosomes serve different protein destinations
understandings.draftSummary: Free: cytosolic enzymes; bound: proteins entering secretory or endomembrane pathway.

understandings.studentTitle: Golgi cisternae process and dispatch secretory proteins
understandings.draftSummary: Rough ER synthesis → vesicular delivery → Golgi processing/sorting → secretory vesicle → plasma membrane fusion.

understandings.studentTitle: Clathrin-coated vesicles help sort membrane cargo
understandings.draftSummary: On the cytosolic surface as a coat assembled through adaptors; it is not the lumenal cargo.
